name: impl-thread-safe-lru
system: You are a senior software engineer. Write production-quality code.
user:
Implement a thread-safe LRU cache in Python with the following interface:

```python
class LRUCache:
    def __init__(self, capacity: int): ...
    def get(self, key) -> Any | None: ...
    def put(self, key, value) -> None: ...
    def __len__(self) -> int: ...
```

Requirements:
- O(1) get and put.
- Safe under concurrent access from multiple threads.
- Evicts the least-recently-used entry when at capacity.
- Update recency on `get` even for hits.

Provide ONLY the implementation, with a one-line comment above the class noting the synchronization strategy.
